topics.name: MeritCore Evidence Identity
topics.purpose: Define each merit-bearing human-interaction evidence record as an explicit identity linked to exact IdentityCore and Project evidence.

semantics.identity_rule: Each merit evidence record has an explicit identity.
semantics.project_rule: Source Project identity/evidence is exact where Project-based.
semantics.interaction_rule: MeritCore covers human-interaction/competence signals rather than arbitrary machine telemetry.
semantics.source_rule: Backend/source writer identity and provenance are explicit.
semantics.time_rule: Merit evidence binds exact registration-anchored week/hour atom.
semantics.authority_rule: Merit evidence grants no AccessCore rights.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: machine telemetry converted to merit silently

references.purpose: Project participation may supply merit evidence.
